title: Industrial electricity price
description: Eurostat industrial electricity prices by country, including taxes and levies, in EUR per kWh. One row per country (ISO geo code + name) and reporting semester (e.g. 2025-S2), with the EU-27 aggregate included for benchmarking. Useful for comparing Finland's energy cost against EU peers. Non-geospatial table — country-level, no geometry.

semantics.label: Industrial electricity price
semantics.describes: Eurostat industrial electricity price by country, including taxes and levies, by reporting semester.
semantics.answers: What is the industrial electricity price (energy cost) in a given country, and how does it compare across the EU?
